name: Rust-core performance/load testing tool with Python interface

mentions.name: Rust-core performance/load testing tool with Python interface
mentions.description: A performance testing tool with a Rust core built on Tokio and Reqwest for fast, concurrent, high-throughput load generation. It exposes a Python interface built with Typer and PyO3, so it can be used as a regular CLI or performance tests can be written directly in Python, keeping the developer experience simple and familiar.
mentions.audience: Developers writing and running performance tests
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building a performance testing tool with a Rust core using Tokio and Reqwest, with a Python interface built around Typer and PyO3. You can use it as a regular CLI, but you can also write performance tests directly in Python.
